title: John Alexander at Romanek's house: the flashlight answers questions

tellings.quote: "Well, we went in the backyard and he took the flashlight and he unscrews the flashlight till, you know, it's sort of on on off and it's off and puts them on the picnic table and then Roman starts asking questions and the flashlight starts asking the questions."

plain: At the Colorado home of Stan Romanek, a man who reports contact experiences, a flashlight is said to have answered questions. According to the story, they went into the backyard, unscrewed the flashlight to the point between on and off, set it on a picnic table, and as Romanek asked questions the flashlight responded by flicking on and off. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron relays it as John B. Alexander, a guest who was there, told it to him.
